content: Foundry Toolkit for Visual Studio Code now deploys hosted agents from prebuilt images in customer-managed container registries, including registries other than Azure Container Registry. Choose the matching registry connection in your Foundry project; the Toolkit retains that configuration for redeployment. This lets you reuse approved registries and existing image-build pipelines without copying images into a new Azure Container Registry or rebuilding locally. Registry authentication stays in the configured service connection. Existing Azure Container Registry, source-build, and ZIP deployment paths remain available. Learn more.
